input.summary: Add general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-out to the mutual non-solicit
input.comment: [Playbook] The mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel involved in the Services is acceptable, but it needs the standard carve-out for general advertising and unsolicited approaches so ordinary recruitment activity is not caught.

ops.oldText: without such other party's express written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: without such other party's express written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. This restriction shall not apply to general advertisements or other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or to the hiring of any person who approaches a party on an unsolicited basis or who responds to such general advertisement.
